Rich removes carriage-return characters from the text it prints (see [`strip_control_codes`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/control.py)), so `\r` does not rewrite the line the way built-in `print()` does. The flush in `rich.print()` only makes output appear sooner; it does not change this.

To update a line in place, use [`Live`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/live.rst), or [`Progress`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/progress.rst) for progress bars. For other questions about usage, [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the right place.
